# dsh-crt-skins

Two retro terminal skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
Same bones, two different screens: both pi

n the DSH design tokens so no DeepSeek
blue leaks through, square off the pill shapes, bracket the p

anels and add
synthesized terminal audio cues. One is amber phosphor, one is Pip-Boy green.
| Skin | Screen | Treatment |

| `dsh-crt-terminal` | amber phosphor | scanlines, curved-screen vignette, slow flicker |
| `dsh-pip
boy-terminal` | Pip-Boy green | stable glass, top sheen, hairline bezel, no animation |
## Install

Both skins can be installed at the same time: they share a registry and only one stays
active, switc
hed with a floating button in the bottom-right corner or `Alt` + `Shift` + `S`.

Restart DSH Web (`dsh web`) after installing or removing a skin.

n a simulated DOM (style injection,
audio listeners, mute toggle, dispose):

## Compatibility
Verified against **DSH Web `0.1.5-rc.1`** and the **DSH desktop app `0.1.7-rc.2`** on Windows 11. Bo

th skins are
client-only: the Node half is deliberately inert, and the stylesheet and audio
listener

s are mounted as one disposable effect, so removing the plugin removes
everything again.
